legal_units.title: Capital gains on distribution of assets by companies in liquidation.
legal_units.text: Irrespective of anything contained in section 67, where the assets of a company are distributed to its shareholders on its liquidation, such distribution shall not be regarded as a transfer by the company for the purposes of the said section.
